+    raw = path.read_bytes()

+    text = raw.decode(encoding, errors="replace")

+    buffers: dict[str, str] = {}

+        if not isinstance(row, dict):
+            continue
+        if "event" in row:
+            events.append(row)
+        elif isinstance(row.get("text"), str):
+            stream = row.get("stream", "stdout")
+            buffers[stream] = buffers.get(stream, "") + row["text"]
